whyItMatters: a New Relic licence key literal assigned to NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY stored in the tree works for anyone holding it until the provider revokes it.
actions: Revoke the token at the provider.
Audit the API calls it made and remediate anything unexpected.
Issue a minimal-scope replacement held in a secret manager.
verification: The revoked token returns an authentication error and no token-shaped literal remains at this name.
